cases.input: A custody record is opened for one asset instance with holderRef, basisOfHolding and validFrom while title remains with the lessor.
cases.expect: The record is valid, is independently identified within the WM-OBJ-001 boundary, and allocates no model or runtime identifier.
cases.violates: Custody is an effective-dated relationship record independently identified within the WM-OBJ-001 boundary and allocates no model or runtime identifier.

cases.input: A second custody record is opened for the same asset instance while the prior record still has no validTo.
cases.expect: The second open record is rejected.
cases.violates: At most one custody record per asset instance has no validTo.

cases.input: The current custodian is reported as the title holder because no other holding is recorded.
cases.violates: Custody implies neither title, operational responsibility, location nor access.

cases.input: The current custodian is treated as the operationally responsible party without a responsibility assignment.
cases.violates: Custody implies neither title, operational responsibility, location nor access.

cases.input: A recorded location change is used to close one custody record and open another.
cases.expect: The derived custody change is rejected.
cases.violates: A location or access change does not imply a custody change.

cases.input: A new model identifier is requested for the custody relationship because it carries its own record identity.
cases.violates: Custody is an effective-dated relationship record independently identified within the WM-OBJ-001 boundary and allocates no model or runtime identifier.

cases.input: Custody transfers between two parties with acknowledgement and condition at handover recorded.
cases.expect: The prior record is closed with validTo, a successor record is opened, and both intervals remain reconstructable.
cases.violates: Custody transfer closes the prior record and opens a successor; neither record is overwritten.

cases.input: A leased instrument has title with the lessor, custody with the enterprise, operational responsibility with a named party, a location assignment at a third site and an access assignment to a fourth group, all on independent effective dates.
cases.expect: All five assignments coexist and remain separately queryable without any one rewriting another.
cases.violates: Title holder, custodian, operationally responsible party, location assignment and access assignment may differ simultaneously and a change to one does not rewrite the others.

cases.input: The WM-ECO-011 holding view is used to assert the current custodian, the responsible party and instrument fitness.
cases.violates: WM-ECO-011 is an aligned holding view and never masters custody, operational responsibility, location, access or fitness.

cases.input: The WM-OBJ-022 accounted-asset projection is used as the instance identity key and as the source of calibration validity.
cases.violates: WM-OBJ-022 is a projection and never masters identity, calibration validity or fitness.

cases.input: Value, depreciation and criticality are read for an asset instance through WM-OBJ-022.
cases.expect: The read succeeds as a projection over WM-OBJ-001 with no second master identity created.
cases.violates: WM-OBJ-022 is a projection and never masters identity, calibration validity or fitness.

cases.input: The Maintenance Plan, Maintenance Event and Calibration Event candidates are validated with modelId null, registryId null and allocationState unassigned.
cases.expect: All three pass validation and remain non-publishable candidates.
cases.violates: EM-OPS-03 allocates no model identifier and no runtime identifier.

cases.input: A WM-prefixed identifier is written into modelId on one of the three candidates.
cases.violates: EM-OPS-03 allocates no model identifier and no runtime identifier.

cases.input: allocationState is set to assigned while registryId remains null and no registry reservation record exists.
cases.violates: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.

cases.input: Fitness is evaluated at query time for a stated purpose from the current configuration, the in-force calibration event and its validity conditions.
cases.expect: A derived fitness assertion is returned with its inputs and evaluation time, stored nowhere as an instrument property and allocating no identifier.
cases.violates: A fitness assertion is derived at evaluation time for a stated purpose and is never stored as a property of the instrument, model or economic view.

cases.input: A fit-for-use flag is written onto the asset instance record after a successful calibration.
cases.violates: A fitness assertion is derived at evaluation time for a stated purpose and is never stored as a property of the instrument, model or economic view.

cases.input: Fitness is asserted with no statedPurpose.
cases.violates: Fitness is derived for a stated use.

cases.input: A fitness assertion for one instrument configuration is extended to every instrument of the same model and to the instrument class.
cases.violates: A fitness assertion is scoped to one instrument configuration and never extends to another serial of the same model.

cases.input: The calibration validity window lapses while an authorized maintenance order remains open.
cases.expect: Fitness evaluates negative for purposes requiring calibration, the prior certificate and all prior assertions remain queryable, and the open order still proves no execution.
cases.violates: Validity expiry, configuration change or purpose change drops the current assertion and leaves all prior assertions and certificates intact.

cases.input: EM-OPS-03 raises a second Operational Responsibility Assignment candidate alongside the EM-LND-17 one.
cases.violates: EM-OPS-03 raises no second operational-responsibility candidate and allocates no identifier for the reused one.

cases.input: A responsibility assignment is recorded without governingBasis or without validFrom.
cases.violates: Responsibility assignment requires basis and interval.

cases.input: The reused EM-LND-17 candidate is cited with sourceContourId EM-LND-17, modelId null, registryId null and allocationState unassigned.
cases.expect: The reuse is accepted and no identifier is allocated.
cases.violates: EM-OPS-03 raises no second operational-responsibility candidate and allocates no identifier for the reused one.

cases.input: A fixture is submitted without target, violates or closesDefect.
cases.violates: Fixtures must carry id, target, kind, input, expect and closesDefect.

cases.input: A negative fixture is submitted with no expectedCode, or with a code absent from the error-code registry.
cases.violates: Every negative fixture carries an expectedCode drawn from the EM-OPS-03 error-code registry.

cases.input: The profile candidate is submitted without canonicalPublishable false and without a holds array.
cases.violates: One frozen semantic audit is complete; base specifications and approved relations remain incomplete.
